tokens.name: background-base
tokens.usage: Page background. Lowest layer; every text color below is checked against it.

tokens.name: background-layer-1
tokens.usage: First raised layer: app panels and side navigation on `background-base`.

tokens.name: background-layer-2
tokens.usage: Second raised layer: cards, tables and field fills on `background-layer-1`.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs and tooltips that float above the page.

tokens.name: fill-neutral-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for quiet buttons, list rows and tabs. A surface state, not a border.

tokens.name: fill-neutral-down
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for quiet buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: content-heading
tokens.usage: Headings and titles on `background-base`, `background-layer-1`, `background-layer-2`, `background-elevated`.

tokens.name: content-default
tokens.usage: Body copy, labels and input values on `background-base`, `background-layer-1`, `background-layer-2`, `background-elevated`.

tokens.name: content-subdued
tokens.usage: Help text, descriptions and secondary labels on the same grounds as `content-default`.

tokens.name: content-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; never use for live content.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Outline of checkboxes, radios and switches (2px) and of quiet outline buttons. Spectrum `neutral-visual-color`. Meets 3:1 on `background-base` and `background-layer-2` in both themes. Text-entry fields use the lighter `border-field`; dropdowns and menu buttons have no outline.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: Resting outline of text fields, text areas and search fields: a light gray (#dadada in light). Decorative-weight: it is about 1.4:1 on white, so every field must also keep a visible label and a background fill; hover steps to `border-field-hover`, focus to `border-focus`.

tokens.name: border-field-hover
tokens.usage: Hover outline of text fields, text areas and search fields (gray-500, 3.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover outline for fields, pickers and checkboxes: one step darker (light) or lighter (dark) than `border-default`.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Outline of a focused text field, textarea or search field: the 2px light gray border turns dark gray (near-white in dark). At least 3:1 on the field background.

tokens.name: fill-picker
tokens.usage: Background of the Dropdown (picker) button, which has no border: a light gray fill that separates it from white text fields. Text on it is `content-default` (4.5:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning on their own; pair with a heading or spacing, never as the only cue.

tokens.name: border-popover
tokens.usage: Outline of menus and pickers popovers. None in light (the shadow separates it); 1px `gray-400` in dark, where shadows vanish.

tokens.name: negative-border-hover
tokens.usage: Outline of an invalid field on hover.

tokens.name: negative-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a field in the invalid state; paired with an alert icon in the field and an error message below. 3:1 on `background-layer-2`.

tokens.name: fill-disabled
tokens.usage: Background of a disabled text field or picker (Spectrum `disabled-background-color`).

tokens.name: border-disabled
tokens.usage: Outline of a disabled field or control. Decorative state, exempt from contrast; the label stays `content-disabled`.

tokens.name: accent-background
tokens.usage: Fill of the accent (primary) button, selected checkbox/radio/switch and progress fill. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-background-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-background-down
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-content
tokens.usage: Links, selected tab labels and accent text on `background-base`, `background-layer-1` and `background-layer-2`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-background`, `negative-background`, `informative-background`, `positive-background`.

tokens.name: neutral-background
tokens.usage: Fill of the neutral (secondary, solid) button and tooltips. Text on it is `on-neutral`.

tokens.name: on-neutral
tokens.usage: Text on `neutral-background`.

tokens.name: negative-background
tokens.usage: Fill for destructive buttons and the error badge. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: negative-content
tokens.usage: Error text and error borders on `background-base`, `background-layer-2`. Always paired with an icon or the word "Error".

tokens.name: informative-background
tokens.usage: Fill for informative badges. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: informative-content
tokens.usage: Informative text and icons on `background-base`, `background-layer-2`.

tokens.name: positive-background
tokens.usage: Fill for positive badges. Text on it is `on-accent`. Always labeled; never a green-versus-red cue alone.

tokens.name: positive-content
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `background-base`, `background-layer-2`. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: notice-background
tokens.usage: Fill for notice (warning) badges. Text on it is `on-notice`.

tokens.name: on-notice
tokens.usage: Text on `notice-background`. Dark in both themes because the orange fill is bright.

tokens.name: notice-content
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `background-base`, `background-layer-2`. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on every surface above.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind drawers and modal dialogs. Content above it sits on `background-elevated`; the scrim itself carries no text.

tokens.name: neutral-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of a neutral `InlineAlert`. Text on it is `content-heading` and `content-default` (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: informative-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of an informative `InlineAlert`, matching its `informative-content` border. Text on it is `content-heading` and `content-default`; the icon and border (`informative-content`) hold 3:1.

tokens.name: positive-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of a positive `InlineAlert`, matching its `positive-content` border. Same text and 3:1 icon rules as `informative-subtle`.

tokens.name: notice-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of a notice `InlineAlert`, matching its `notice-content` border. Same text and 3:1 icon rules as `informative-subtle`.

tokens.name: negative-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background of a negative `InlineAlert`, matching its `negative-content` border. Same text and 3:1 icon rules as `informative-subtle`.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for table rows, list rows and tree rows: 7% `gray-900`. Text on it stays `content-default` (contrast is unchanged within 0.1).

tokens.name: selected-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected table row, list row or tree row: 10% `blue-900`. Selection is also shown by a checkbox, check icon or filled control, never by this tint alone.

tokens.name: selected-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on an already selected row: 15% `blue-900`.
